rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a cloud in the sky.

example.english: The cloud cover is really thick today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 wan4 hou2 hau5

rows.note: Use this for a visible mass or haze of smoke, steam, or fine dust rather than a sky cloud.

example.english: The cloud of haze filled the whole street early this morning.
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 hai6 jin1 mou6
